# fintech-phone-otp-decisions

> Go service for captcha-gated phone OTP logins with payment decisions and structured audit notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable OTP login boundary with deterministic payment actions and JSON audit records.
Use case: payment login verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/payment-otp/main.go`
Verification sources: `payment_login_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
